preToolUse.bash: d="$PWD"; while [ ! -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/agent-env" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; if [ -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/agent-env" ]; then exec "$d/node_modules/.bin/agent-env" hook pre-tool-use --agent copilot; fi; exit 0

sessionEnd.bash: d="$PWD"; while [ ! -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/agent-env" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; if [ -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/agent-env" ]; then exec "$d/node_modules/.bin/agent-env" hook session-end --agent copilot; fi; exit 0
